Read a configuration file

Source: R/config.R
tlf_config_read.Rd

Reads a YAML file with optional top-level keys page, fonts, header_left, header_right, palette, trt_candidates and render. The page, fonts and render keys hold the arguments of tlf_page(), tlf_fonts() and tlf_render_opts(). This function requires the yaml package.

Usage

tlf_config_read(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a YAML file.

Value

A tlf_config.

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
writeLines(c("header_left: Example Organization", "fonts:", "  text_size: 8"), f)
tlf_config_read(f)
#> <tlf_config>
#>   page    : landscape 11x8.5 in, margins 0.5/0.5/0.5/0.5/0.5/0.5; figure body 9x6 in
#>   text    : Courier New 8 (source 8)
#>   figure  : Arial 10 (allowed 9-10)
#>   header  : left='Example Organization' right='Page \pagenumber of \pagefield'
#>   render  : isolate=TRUE retries=2 timeout=90s dpi=300
unlink(f)
